recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#f5f5f5). 2. Add title 'Sigmoid vs Tanh' at top center in bold red (#c0392b), sans-serif, large size. 3. Add yellow circle with '26' at top-right corner. 4. Create two rows of equation boxes. Row 1 left: 'f(x) = Sigmoid(x) = 1/(1+e^-x) ⇒ f'(x) = f(x)(1-f(x))'. Row 1 right in cream box (#fdf2e9): 'at x=0   f(0)=0.5   f'(0)=0.25'. Row 2 left: 'f(x) = tanh(x) = sinh x / cosh x ⇒ f'(x) = 1-f(x)^2'. Row 2 right in cream box: 'at x=0   f(0)=0     f'(0)=1'. 5. Add two line charts side by side in center. Left chart: title 'Sigmoid vs Tanh', y-axis -1.00 to 1.00, x-axis -4 to 4, red Tanh line and blue Sigmoid line, legend top-left. Right chart: title 'Sigmoid vs Tanh', y-axis 0.0 to 1.0, x-axis -4 to 4, green Tanh Derivative line and purple Sigmoid Derivative line, legend top-right, red annotations '1.0' and '0.25' with horizontal lines. 6. Add footer box with red border containing: '[1] The range of the sigmoid function is fixed at 0 to 1, whereas the range of the tanh function is fixed at -1 to 1.' and '[2] The sigmoid function has a slower rate of change than the tanh function, which means that the derivative of the sigmoid function will be smaller than the derivative of the tanh function for a given input'. Apply yellow highlights to: '0 to 1', '-1 to 1', 'sigmoid', 'tanh', 'smaller', 'sigmoid', 'tanh' as seen in the image.
